CCM.Name: 001 Modulation
CCM.Memo: Vibrato depth (pitch modulation); its range is set by RPN Modulation Depth Range (CCM 155).

CCM.Name: 002 Breath
CCM.Memo: Breath controller.

CCM.Name: 004 Foot
CCM.Memo: Foot controller.

CCM.Name: 007 Volume
CCM.Memo: Part volume (absolute). Use Expression for changes while notes are playing.

CCM.Name: 010 Panpot
CCM.Memo: Stereo position: 64 = center.

CCM.Name: 011 Expression
CCM.Memo: Volume relative to CC7 Volume, for changes while notes are playing.

CCM.Name: 005 Portamento Time
CCM.Memo: Glide time between notes while Portamento is ON.

CCM.Name: 065 Portamento
CCM.Memo: Glide between successive notes (64-127 = ON).

CCM.Name: 064 Hold Pedal
CCM.Memo: Sustain: notes keep sounding after Note Off while ON (64-127). Turn it OFF afterwards.

CCM.Name: 066 Sostenuto
CCM.Memo: Sustains only the notes held when it is pressed (64-127 = ON).

CCM.Name: 067 Soft
CCM.Memo: Soft pedal: softer, darker notes while ON (64-127).

CCM.Name: 070 Sound Variation
CCM.Memo: Sound variation (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 071 Resonance
CCM.Memo: Filter resonance, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 072 Release Time
CCM.Memo: Envelope release, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 073 Attack Time
CCM.Memo: Envelope attack, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 074 Cutoff
CCM.Memo: Filter cutoff (brightness), relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 075 Decay Time
CCM.Memo: Envelope decay, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 076 Vibrato Rate
CCM.Memo: Vibrato rate, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 077 Vibrato Depth
CCM.Memo: Vibrato depth, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 078 Vibrato Delay
CCM.Memo: Delay before vibrato, relative (64 = original sound).

CCM.Name: 091 Reverb
CCM.Memo: Reverb send level.

CCM.Name: 093 Chorus
CCM.Memo: Chorus send level.

CCM.Name: 101 RPN MSB
CCM.Memo: Selects an RPN with CC100, then CC6 (and CC38) set its value.

CCM.Name: 100 RPN LSB
CCM.Memo: Selects an RPN with CC101, then CC6 (and CC38) set its value.

CCM.Name: 006 Data Entry MSB
CCM.Memo: Value of the selected RPN.

CCM.Name: 038 Data Entry LSB
CCM.Memo: Fine value of the selected RPN.

CCM.Name: 120 All Sound Off
CCM.Memo: Silences the channel immediately.

CCM.Name: 121 Reset All Controllers
CCM.Memo: Resets modulation, expression, pedals, pitch bend, channel pressure and the RPN selection.

CCM.Name: 123 All Notes Off
CCM.Memo: Releases all notes (ignored while the hold pedal is ON).

CCM.Name: 126 Mono Mode
CCM.Memo: One note at a time on the channel (GM2: value 1).

CCM.Name: 127 Poly Mode
CCM.Memo: Back to polyphonic mode.

CCM.Name: 128 Channel Pressure
CCM.Memo: Channel aftertouch.

CCM.Name: 130 Pitch Bend
CCM.Memo: Pitch change; its range is set by RPN Pitch Bend Sensitivity (CCM 151).

CCM.Name: 151 Pitch Bend Sensitivity
CCM.Memo: Pitch bend range in semitones (GM2 default: 2).

CCM.Name: 152 Fine Tuning
CCM.Memo: Channel fine tuning: -8192..+8191 = -100..+100 cents.

CCM.Name: 153 Coarse Tuning
CCM.Memo: Channel transposition in semitones (64 = none).

CCM.Name: 155 Modulation Depth Range
CCM.Memo: Maximum depth of the modulation (CC1), in semitones (MSB); GM2 default: 50 cents.

CCM.Name: 154 RPN Null
CCM.Memo: Deselects the RPN, so that later Data Entry messages are ignored.

CCM.Name: 147 GM2 System On
CCM.Memo: Resets the module to General MIDI Level 2. Leave about 100 ms before the next message.

CCM.Name: 148 GM System Off
CCM.Memo: Leaves General MIDI mode (back to the module's own mode).

CCM.Name: 131 Master Volume
CCM.Memo: Universal SysEx Master Volume (all channels).

CCM.Name: 132 Master Balance
CCM.Memo: Universal SysEx Master Balance: 64 = center.

CCM.Name: 133 Master Coarse Tuning
CCM.Memo: Universal SysEx Master Coarse Tuning: transposition of all channels (64 = none).

CCM.Name: 255 Rest
CCM.Memo: Rest: removed when exporting a standard MIDI file. Use it to space events.
